name: clathrin heavy chain

function.text: CLTC encodes clathrin heavy chain 1. Annotated molecular activities include structural molecule activity and double-stranded RNA binding. It participates in chromosome segregation and clathrin-dependent endocytosis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 56 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-positive histiocytosis; ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
